claim: Patchline ships a self-supervised pretraining objective over schemas with a downstream-accuracy gate. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the self-supervised claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make schema-self-supervised-pretrain-gate`.
